sorries.obstruction: the bare DEC-44 form (locally Cauchy only), stated as gx's target and open in ETT generality, possibly false: (1) no global projection: without a splitting or covering map of M there is nothing to compare Σ with (Brunswic's covering step uses N ≃ Σ_N × ℝ); (2) no two-sidedness: in a chart U a point near Σ may be related to Σ ∩ U only through points of Σ outside U, so the box step's time window is uncontrolled, and excluding it needs global acausality of Σ, which is the conclusion. Proved under both data as isCauchySurface_of_isLocallyCauchyTwoSided. No declaration depends on it (sorryAx appears only in its own #print axioms).

findings: DEC-44's hypotheses as dispatched (locally Cauchy only) are not what this library can prove from: the proved form needs (a) a global splitting, to compare Σ with the lines (Brunswic's projection/covering step), and (b) two-sidedness in the charts, without which the time window of the box step is uncontrolled: a point of U near Σ may be related to Σ only through points of Σ outside U, which only the conclusion (global acausality) would exclude. Both are what 'spacelike hypersurface' (Barbot Rem 2.3, §11) means in the smooth setting, so this is not a defect of the paper.

Chronal splitting lines would be the cheap route to the box step and are impossible for gx: at a BTZ point I^-(p) = ∅ (SingularFlatAxioms.Iminus_eq_empty; lem:past_BTZ), so a splitting line through a BTZ point contains the BTZ half-line below it and is not chronal. The proof therefore uses only causally monotone lines (exactly IsCauchySplitting) and pays with two-sidedness, which holds at BTZ points (the line point above x is in the interior of J^+_U(Σ ∩ U)).

Brunswic arXiv 2108.12631, prop:cauchy_abs_max (BTZ_1.tex:1048-1074, the unnumbered 'propou' the dispatch calls Prop 2.16): the covering argument (projection is a local diffeomorphism, proper, a covering; the lowest-point section is continuous) is rebuilt without covering theory: the set of points of Σ that are lowest on their line is shown open and closed in Σ (exists_graph); the intersection-number step ('inextendible causal curves are all homotopic ... intersection number 1') is replaced by the sign of F = τ − h∘π and the intermediate value theorem; O'Neill's Lemma 14.45 (achronality from π₁-surjectivity) is replaced by the local sign structure at each crossing (isAcausal_of_graph). Brunswic's continuity step argues with sequences; none is needed.

Barbot's 'any spacelike hypersurface in a given CGH spacetime is a Cauchy hypersurface' (Rem 2.3) still needs 'closed' and 'connected' (the slab counterexample lives in a Flat file; a disjoint union of two Cauchy slices is a compact disconnected locally Cauchy set met twice by every inextensible curve).
questions: Is two-sidedness (IsOpen (C.Jplus U (S ∩ U) \ S) and IsOpen (C.Jminus U (S ∩ U) \ S) in each chart) an acceptable reading of 'locally Cauchy' / 'spacelike' for DEC-44? gx must discharge it in its singular charts; for U = M it follows from a splitting along S (IsCauchySurface.isLocallyCauchyTwoSided_of_splitting).

Is a GLOBAL splitting of M (IsCauchySplitting S₀ ψ, DEC-32) the data gx will supply near BTZ lines? The lemma needs one splitting of the whole spacetime, with causally monotone lines; S₀ need not be Cauchy and ψ(x,0) = x is not used.

Pattern: in a causally arc-connected spacetime, inside a causally convex open U the relation ≤_U is ≤_⊤ restricted (le_of_causallyConvexIn with V = U), and a ⊤-monotone segment between two points of U stays in U: no curve has to be checked to stay in U.

Pattern: a covering-space argument over a splitting (projection of a compact Σ is a covering, the lowest-point section is continuous) becomes: the set of lowest points is open and closed in Σ, then isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_disjoint with u, v the unions of the witnessing open sets.

Pattern: 'an inextensible curve leaves J^-(K), K compact' needs no time function: cover K by finitely many open diamonds (tarentin), the tail lies in finitely many compact diamonds, its cluster point bounds the curve above (J^+(c s) closed), and extensible_of_forall_ge applies (exists_not_mem_Jminus_of_isCompact).
